answer: Each identity registers a hash of its weights, like a ship tied to one wharf: two identities whose weights match above 98% count as clones of one operator and both lose their seats. Peers check similarity each epoch; a farm must train 100 genuinely different models at 400 GPU-hours each, not copy one. A lone yarrow of honest work stands apart; cloned weights stretch toward a false horizon and collapse under the check.
